title: amylose-linkage-landscape: code and data for "Conformational Energy Landscape of the α(1→4) Linkage and the Dimensions of Amylose in Water"
description: GFN2-xTB (φ,ψ) scans of methyl α-maltoside in ALPB water, GBSA water and vacuum; the validated energy maps; the chain builder, frame validation, exact transfer-matrix and Monte Carlo codes; the r2SCAN benchmark; the MD analysis scripts; and the numerical results behind every table and figure of the paper. MD trajectories are available from the corresponding author on request.
